coverage.evidence: Helper keys and argument forms match PollStateHelpers.cs:19-30, PollOptionHelpers.cs:17-45, PollLeadingHelpers.cs:19-40, PollLastHelpers.cs:17-22 and PredictionOutcomeHelpers.cs:18-63; a wrong argument count gives null and the token stays as written (PollRow.cs:65, ITemplateHelperProvider.cs:42).

Leading, tie, percent and ends-at rules match PollText.cs:27-38 and 61-75; prediction leading, odds and time left match PredictionText.cs:45-91; number and duration formats match StreamText.cs:27-30 and 68-75, NumberText.cs:29 and MeterBars.cs:17-20.

Live helpers use TemplateHelperContexts.Standard, which is every context except Viewer (PollRow.cs:88, PredictionRow.cs:99, TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22); event values are EventSourceOnly or EventSourceAndDiscord Literals (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:102-115, 246-354).

Open, locked and status words match PredictionText.cs:25-36 and 85-91; the first unfinished prediction is kept (LivePredictionData.cs:60-74); only an ACTIVE poll is kept (LivePollData.cs:58-72); last ended and history order match PollPredictionFetch.cs:73 and PollPredictionHistoryService.cs:28-29, 35, 72.

Poll event values and the completed-only gate match PollEventHandler.cs:38-45, 75-103 and TwitchAlertHandlerBase.cs:141-150, 163, 185; prediction event values match PredictionEventHandler.cs:39-46, 80-86, 118-129; Discord values match DiscordPollEndNotificationHandler.cs:38-56 and DiscordPredictionResolvedNotificationHandler.cs:38-54.

reader_answers.evidence: The Poll ends event values poll.title, winner, winner.votes, winner.percentage and results are seeded at PollEventHandler.cs:75-97; prediction.question, leading, leading.percent, timeLeft and status.now exist at PredictionStateHelpers.cs:19-35 and PredictionTotalsHelpers.cs; numbered helpers take one argument (PollOptionHelpers.cs:17-45); last.question and last.winner are at PollLastHelpers.cs:17-22 and PredictionLastHelpers.cs:17-21.

The two scopes are defined at TwitchScopes.cs:90 and 92 and required by TwitchPollsApi.cs:32-42 and TwitchPredictionsApi.cs:36-46; the base broadcaster grant leaves them out (TwitchLoginScopes.cs:56-61); Grant permissions is on Integrations (settings/integrations/i18n/en.json:7-10, MissingTwitchScopesNotice.vue:58-83).

Live helpers run in Command and Timer through Standard (TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22), while event values are limited to EventResponse, Pipeline and Discord (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:102-115); status.now gives open for ACTIVE and the lowercase status otherwise, so locked (PredictionText.cs:31-36).

Poll ends responds only for completed (PollEventHandler.cs:100-101); with no votes, OrderByDescending(...).FirstOrDefault() names the first choice (PollEventHandler.cs:77, 84); timeLeft is empty once the prediction is not open (PredictionText.cs:85-91).
